title: Consumption Record
description: A deterministic, metadata-only observation that a Finding produced by federation-recon is referenced somewhere in the observed federation. No source excerpts (FR-CON-008). See founding package §18, F-02.

referencing_repository.description: Owner/repo slug of the repository that references a Finding

referencing_file_path.description: Path within the referencing repository where the reference was found

repository_pin.description: Path to the repository pin of the referencing repository

cycle.description: Which operational cycle this observation belongs to (1-based, derived from committed artifacts)
